meta.name: book-cover-design
meta.description: Book cover design with genre-specific conventions, typography rules, and AI image generation. Covers fiction and non-fiction genres, sizing, thumbnail testing, and iteration workflows. Use for: self-publishing, ebook covers, print covers, audiobook covers, cover mockups. Triggers: book cover, cover design, ebook cover, book art, novel cover, self publishing cover, kindle cover, audiobook cover, book jacket, cover illustration, fiction cover, nonfiction cover

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为书籍设计符合体裁规范的封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为小说或非虚构书籍设计专业封面
copy.tagline_en: Design book covers with genre-specific conventions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional covers for fiction or nonfiction books

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据书籍类型（如小说、非虚构）设计封面，包括配色、字体和构图建议，并调用 AI 生成封面图像。
howto.when: 当你提到“封面设计”、“电子书封面”、“小说封面”等关键词，或要求设计书籍封面时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一本悬疑小说的封面。
say.note: Claude 会给出悬疑风格的配色、字体和图像提示。

say.text: 生成一个浪漫小说封面概念图。
say.note: Claude 会调用 AI 生成符合浪漫风格的封面图像。

say.text: 我的封面在缩略图下看不清标题，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议调整标题大小和布局。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design book covers based on genre (fiction, non-fiction), including color palette, typography, and composition advice, and generate cover images via AI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "book cover", "cover design", "ebook cover", "novel cover", or ask to design a book cover.

say_en.text: Design a thriller book cover for me.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest thriller-style colors, fonts, and image prompts.

say_en.text: Generate a romance novel cover concept.
say_en.note: Claude will call AI to generate a romance-style cover image.

say_en.text: My cover title is unreadable at thumbnail size, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will advise adjusting title size and layout.
